info.title: marginalia
info.description: Scans a folder of C# source and produces a clean Markdown inventory of its types — classes, interfaces, enums, records and more — with an open Notes column ready for refactoring guidance.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Scans a .NET codebase and writes a Markdown inventory of its types, ready for refactoring notes.

options.name: --output
options.description: Where to write the Markdown file. Defaults to ./code-inventory.md.

options.name: --title
options.description: Heading for the document. Defaults to the solution, project, or folder name.

options.name: --no-clipboard
options.description: Do not copy the generated Markdown to the clipboard. [default: False]

options.name: --no-open
options.description: Do not open the generated file in VS Code. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Directory to scan, or a file whose containing folder is scanned. Defaults to the current directory. [default: .]
